bio: I work closely with the Faculty Deans and other House staff. I plan many of the House events, run the housing lottery, house the sophomores and help manage our finances. I have been at Harvard for 22 years and Eliot for 20 of them. Community Eliot House Area Residential Life Role Residential House Administrators
